concerns.text: FR-001 ends with '(See US-1)' but no User Story or requirement labeled US-1 exists in the document; the only user stories are titled 'User Story 1', 'User Story 2', etc.
FR-002, FR-003, FR-004, and FR-007 each reference '(See US-2)' which is undefined; there is no US-2 identifier elsewhere.
FR-005 and FR-006 reference '(See US-3)' but no US-3 identifier is defined in the spec.

FR-002 permits skipping energy aggregation when pyRAPL and external wattmeter are unavailable, yet FR-004 *must* aggregate energy‑per‑token, latency, and perplexity for each configuration. This creates a contradictory requirement when energy data is missing.

The assumptions describe the evaluation hardware as both a GitHub Actions free‑tier x86 runner and a Raspberry Pi 4 (via QEMU). The spec does not explicitly state a scope shift or dual‑hardware strategy, leading to an implicit scope change without clarification.
